cosmicText: Patience will be your greatest ally today. The Moon is in a complex position, so avoid making hasty decisions in property or legal matters. Wear the color white for mental peace and meditate for 10 minutes to align your energies.

predictions.label: Love & Relations
predictions.text: Venus aligns beautifully today, bringing warmth to your relationships. Deep conversations with loved ones will strengthen bonds. Single? A chance encounter may spark something special.

predictions.label: Career & Finance
predictions.text: Mercury's position favors professional growth. An opportunity for advancement may present itself. Stay confident in negotiations and trust your instincts with financial decisions.

predictions.label: Health & Wellbeing
predictions.text: Your energy levels are high today. This is an excellent time for physical activities or starting a new wellness routine. Stay hydrated and maintain balance in all things.

predictions.label: Travel & Luck
predictions.text: Jupiter brings fortunate opportunities, especially in travel or learning. Short trips will be rewarding. Lady Luck is on your side – consider trying something new today!
